title: Harness fixtures get the posture and SAVED-CHAT block production always sends
evidence: Found in PR 1652 (T-5). A fixture with no surface gets no posture, and a doctor fixture with no user_context gets no SAVED-CHAT block (SAVED_CHAT_DEFAULT in tools/chatbot-surfaces.ts). Production's /api/chat always sends both: DOCTOR_POSTURE by default and savedChatOf(retention) (app/routes/api.chat.ts:494). Fix, option (a), its own PR: default a fixture with no surface to doctor, with production's SAVED-CHAT block. Its PR body must say scored answers will shift once, so the next paid run sets a new baseline.
